summary: Independent adversarial review of 80 runs (40 samples = 20 patients x primary lung + brain metastasis, duplicate injections). Every per-row clinical value, file->sample mapping, technical parameter and ontology term was re-derived from the deposited ID sheet, Table S1, supplementary methods and RAW headers; no discrepancies found. Only minor findings remain.

reviewer_context.context: fresh reviewer agent without producer transcript; producer report.md not relied upon

spec_compliance.evidence: 43 columns; templates ms-proteomics v1.1.0, human v1.1.0, clinical-metadata v1.0.0, oncology-metadata v1.0.0 (all present in installed template dir). No duplicate assay names or data files; 80 rows; structured NT=/AC= syntax valid; age ranges (e.g. 41Y-42Y) permitted by spec README line 1382.

ontology_integrity.evidence: Resolved in offline caches: NCIT C27966/C28054/C27970/C27971 stage I-IV, C67148/C67147/C65108 former/current/never smoker, C3512 lung adenocarcinoma (also MONDO:0005061, EFO_0000571); UBERON:0002048 lung, UBERON:0000955 brain; PATO male/female; PRIDE:0000627 DDA, PRIDE:0000608 DTT, PRIDE:0000599 IAA; MS:1002877 Q Exactive HF-X, MS:1001251 trypsin, MS:1001309 Lys-C, MS:1000422 beam-type CID; UNIMOD:4/35/1. Phenotype values are free text (allowed by TERMS.tsv).

source_evidence.evidence: Script re-derived for all 80 rows: sex, smoking (2/1/0 code), pathological stage, fast/slow progression, EGFR/KRAS genotype, and age (Table S1 age, + lung-brain interval for metastasis rows, whole-year range convention) - 0 mismatches. Fast/slow cut-off (<=365 / >365 days) confirmed in manuscript. Instrument HF-X confirmed by RAW headers and supp. methods (PRIDE record's 'Q Exactive HF' is the less accurate source). Lys-C then trypsin, DTT, IAA, NCE 28, top-20 DDA, 10 ppm / 0.02 Da, CAM fixed, Ox(M) and protein N-term acetyl variable all in supplementary methods. reconcile BLOCKER 'trypsin not named in record' refuted: PRIDE record gives no enzyme; supp. methods state trypsin.

file_mapping.evidence: PRIDE file list: 83 files, 80 .raw; SDRF lists exactly those 80 (0 missing, 0 extra, 0 duplicates). Non-raw mzML/mzid.gz/xlsx correctly excluded. Every RAW sample number maps through the deposited ID sheet to the stated source name; R1/R2 suffix equals comment[technical replicate].

design_consistency.evidence: 40 source names x 2 injections; 20 individuals each with one pLADC and one mLADC sample; factors phenotype (primary vs brain metastasis, 40/40 runs) and clinical history (fast 22+22 runs = 11 patients, slow 18+18 = 9 patients) equal their characteristics columns row-by-row; matches paper's two comparison axes.

omission_safety.evidence: Every per-sample value traced to Table S1/ID sheet/methods; derived values (metastasis-row age, metastasis-row stage IV) are documented in manifest limitations and are logically entailed (BM = distant M1 disease; interval defined as diagnosis-to-BM-surgery). No cohort-level values propagated as per-sample facts; 'not available' used where EGFR and KRAS both NA.

deterministic_validation.evidence: flock ... parse_sdrf validate-sdrf -t ms-proteomics -t human -t clinical-metadata -t oncology-metadata --use_ols_cache_only: exit 0, only warnings (free-text phenotype not in PATO/EFO). sdrf-tools check --offline: CLEAN (0 hallucinated). sdrf-tools score: 82/100 (consistency flag on age ranges, which the spec allows). sdrf-tools reconcile: 1 flag, refuted above.

findings.message: Acquisition batch confound (primary runs 20191128/20191201 'LUAD_pilot'; metastasis runs 20191206 'LUAD_B_pilot') is only in the manifest limitations; consider encoding it in the licensed comment[lc batch] column.
findings.evidence: RAW file-name prefixes; TERMS.tsv lists comment[lc batch] for ms-proteomics.

findings.message: Material evidence not encoded: FFPE preservation, single vs multiple brain metastases (a comparison axis in the paper), cTNM, tumour content; mLADC-19 outlier exclusion not flagged. Optional columns (e.g. characteristics[tumor stage], comment[...]) could carry some of this.
findings.evidence: Table S1 columns 'Brain metastases', cT/cN/cM, tumour content; supp. methods (FFPE, outlier mLADC-19).

findings.message: Primary rows use age at LADC diagnosis; for the three synchronous patients whose BM was treated first the primary resection occurred later, so age at sampling may be slightly understated. Range convention otherwise sound.
findings.evidence: Table S1 negative lung-brain intervals (-50, -69, -25 d); manuscript 'three patients ... were first treated for their BMs'.

findings.message: Recommended human-template columns characteristics[ancestry category] and characteristics[developmental stage] absent (could be 'not available' / adult).
Free-text phenotype values trigger validator warnings; acceptable per TERMS.tsv, but an ontology-backed alternative (or relying on organism part + metastasis site) would be cleaner.
